description.text: Short-term courses which are open in July and August run from three to six weeks each, with a total of 24 class hours per week. Depending on the students’ needs and their level of proficiency in Chinese, the courses may include comprehensive Chinese, intensive Chinese listening , oral Chinese practice , and Chinese reading. During the courses, extra curriculum activities such as sightseeing tours and other excursions are organized so as to help students get to know more about Chinese customs and have direct contact with the Chinese society.

duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Language Programs at Yanshan University is a 4 Months long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 347 USD/In total ￥ 2500 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.
